title: Impanuro zinditswe mu bukerebutsi
intro: Ibaze ko uhagaze iruhande y’ikigereranyo kitazwi kubera ibitangaro canke ubwami, ariko kizwi kubera amajambo agiyobora imitima n’ubu. Uwo musuku wa Allah yararonse ingabirano y’agaciro, asuka ugukenguruka mu mpanuro yose yahawe umwigishwa akiri muto akundwa.
clues: Nahezagiwe na Allah n’ubwenge, kandi nategetswe kubukengurukira.
Naravuganye n’umuhungu wanje n’impanuro y’ikibabarwe, ndamugabisha n’urukundo n’ukwitwararika.
Nabwiye umuhungu wanje ko gufatanya abafatanyabikorwa na Allah ari ikibi gikomeye cane.
Nahanuriye umuhungu wanje gushinga amasengesho, gutegeka iciza, kubuza ikibi, no kwihangana.
Naragabishije umuhungu wanje ngo ntahindukire itama mu bwibone canke ngo agende kw’isi mu bwibone.
Narigishije umuhungu wanje guca mu rugero ruringaniye no guca bugufi, kuko amajwi akomeye kuruta ayandi yose ari uguboroga kw’indogoba.

trial.label: Impanuro yanje ihambaye kuruta izindi zose
options: Guhanura umwana wanje ngo ntiyifatanye na Allah
Kubaka ubwato kugira barokoke umwuzure mwinshi .
Kumirwa n'ifi nini yo mu kiyaga .
trial.answer: Guhanura umwana wanje ngo ntiyifatanye na Allah

location.label: Ingabire Nahawe
options: Intebe y'ubwami yitwawe mu kanya nk'ako gukubita urugohe .

outcome.label: Uko nibukwa
options: Nk’uko umuntu yarohamye mu mwuzure kubera ukutemera .
Nk’umuntu yasambutse n’igisasu gikomeye kivuye mw’ijuru .
Nk’uko umuntu yahindutse kubera guca ku Isabato .

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
